recipe.name: Oculus / Delft clay / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Starting shrink allowance; confirm with the caster's alloy, sand and measured trials.

manufacturing.bench_notes: Two-part Delft clay, parting on the band's mid-plane, pull along the finger. Each half of every light is a drafted sand pin hanging from its own mould half; ram the pins firmly and trial one flask before a run. Dress the parting seam through the lights with a needle file; polish the side faces and crown, leave the lights satin.
